SUPERSEDES_NAMING: Not 'Executive v0 (PRE_DECISION only)' -- that framing assumed a zero-compute routing decision made from question-text features alone. The actual architecture that emerged is a different control problem: CHEAP_ANSWER_PROBE -> {ACCEPT, ESCALATE_TO_MEMORY}. ANSWER_NOW always runs first (it is the cheap action by definition); the gate decides whether to ALSO invoke CERTIFIED_MEMORY_V1 based on that probe's own output/confidence. hrm_adaptive_memory/experiment_integrity/executive_features.py's POST_ANSWER_NOW_PRE_MEMORY stage already reflects this; this document names the artifact itself accurately.
DATA_UNCHANGED: data/hrm/exec_training_v1/ (144 tasks: 72 ANSWER_NOW_viable + 72 MEMORY_required) is NOT regenerated or redesigned for this protocol -- per explicit instruction, do not touch it before seeing the collection result. scripts/run_exec_training_v1_collection.py was extended (before any GPU run occurred against it) to capture the full feature set below; this is preparation, not redesign of frozen data.
FEATURES_COLLECTED: answer_now_mean_entropy (full-distribution Shannon entropy, not just top-1)
TARGET: Delta_U_i = Q_memory_i - Q_direct_i (per task, from actual measured action value -- NOT a family label). The gate must predict whether escalation improves utility, not which synthetic family a task came from.
PROCESSING_ORDER: 1. Run the (already-built, unmodified) 144-task collection exactly once. Freeze raw receipts.

2. STOP-GATE: inspect whether confidence features separate MEMORY-strict-win / ANSWER-strict-win / TIE groups (see SEPARATION_CRITERION). If no feature clears the frozen threshold, STOP -- do not train. A controller cannot learn useful routing from a signal with no action-value information; this is a valid, useful negative result, not a failure requiring feature engineering after the fact.
3. Only if separation exists: split into train/eval (see SPLIT), train the smallest possible policy (see MODEL_LADDER), evaluate on the held-out split.

4. If the trained gate passes (see PROMOTION_CRITERIA): generate a fresh, untouched executive-confirmation split and run the frozen gate exactly once, per the qualification-then-confirmation discipline already used for CERTIFIED_MEMORY_V1 itself.

SEPARATION_CRITERION.rule: For at least one of the 5 collected features, EITHER |Cohen's d| >= 0.3 between MEMORY_strict_win and ANSWER_strict_win, OR the grouped bootstrap 95% CI (resampled by family, reusing hrm_adaptive_memory.experiment_integrity.executive_bootstrap's resampling convention) of the mean difference between those two groups excludes zero.
SEPARATION_CRITERION.rationale: 0.3 is a conventional 'small-to-medium' Cohen's d threshold -- deliberately not a strict/high bar, since even a modest separation is enough to be worth attempting the smallest possible model on; a genuinely near-zero effect (d<0.1, CI straddling zero) is the actual stop condition.

SPLIT.method: stratified 70/30 by suite_family (ANSWER_NOW_viable / MEMORY_required), fixed seed 9801, decided now before any collection result exists

MODEL_LADDER.rule: Start with the smallest possible model. Logistic regression (or, if separation is driven by a single feature, a single fitted threshold) over the 5 features above. Do NOT start with a neural controller -- only escalate model complexity if logistic regression demonstrably fails to capture available separation, and only as an explicitly separate, later experiment.
MODEL_LADDER.fitting_library: no new heavy ML dependency -- implement logistic regression directly (gradient descent or closed-form via a small numpy routine) to keep this artifact as dependency-light as the rest of this project's tooling

EVALUATION_HIERARCHY: E2_fixed_confidence_threshold (single scalar cutoff, fit on TRAIN split only)
E4_oracle_escalation (per-task argmax, tie->ACCEPT_DIRECT, same tie-break convention as EOB-v1/v2)
PRIMARY_METRIC: Delta_U_gate = U(E3) - max(U(E0), U(E1)) -- utility improvement over the best FIXED policy. NOT routing accuracy: a gate that predicts action labels well but produces no utility gain over the better fixed policy has not demonstrated anything useful.

ASYMMETRIC_ERROR_METRICS_REQUIRED.P_accept_direct_given_memory_would_impro: the dangerous failure mode -- the system confidently stops while missing needed external information. Must be reported explicitly, never folded into aggregate accuracy.
ASYMMETRIC_ERROR_METRICS_REQUIRED.P_escalate_given_direct_was_already_suff: wasted memory calls, and the D2/D3-style risk (already observed in EOB-v1/v2) that invoking memory can actively harm an already-correct answer.

PROMOTION_CRITERIA.on_eval_split: Delta_U_gate > 0 with a positive grouped-bootstrap LCB (same convention as EOB-v1/v2 and HRM qualification -- resampled by family, not by task)
PROMOTION_CRITERIA.if_not_met: do not build an executive-confirmation split; report the negative result with the same rigor as every other negative result in this project (RUN_VALID, formal GateResult, no post-hoc threshold tuning).

WHAT_IS_NOT_TOUCHED: CERTIFIED_MEMORY_V1, the graph, the composer, retrieval, HRM, or any benchmark threshold. This entire protocol is scoped to a new, separate escalation-gate artifact built on top of the frozen, unchanged memory operation.
